0841 'Asar'elah {a-sar-e:'-la:}

與 0840 同源; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Asarelah 1; 1

亞薩利拉 = "神持守"
1) 亞薩的眾子之一, 被大衛指派唱聖樂的工作 (#代上 25:2|)

0841 'Asar'elah {as-ar-ale'-aw}

from the same as 0840;; n pr m

AV - Asarelah 1; 1

Asarelah = "God holds"
1) a son of Asaph, appointed sanctuary musician by David
